name: vacation-management-interface
description: Runs the database, backend and frontend together

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && node scripts/copy-env.mjs && docker compose up -d --wait && npm run migration:run --prefix backend && npm run seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:api --prefix backend
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && npm run migration:run --prefix backend && npm run seed --prefix backend
